title: Aligning Large Language Models with Human Feedback: Mathematical Foundations and Algorithm Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.31862v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This article provides an introduction to the mathematical foundations and algorithmic frameworks used to align Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intentions, preferences, and values. We discuss standard alignment techniques, such as fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and direct preference optimization (DPO). We also explore the theoretical underpinnings of learning from human preferences, drawing connections to inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) and discrete choice models. We present state-of-the-art algorithms in a tutorial style, discuss their advantages and limitations, and offer insights into practical implementation. Our exposition is intended to serve as a comprehensive resource for researchers and practitioners, providing both a foundational understanding of alignment methodologies and a framework for developing more robust and scalable alignment techniques.

translated_title: 基于人类反馈的大语言模型对齐：数学基础与算法设计
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了用于使大语言模型（LLM）与人类意图、偏好和价值观对齐的数学基础与算法框架。我们讨论了标准的对齐技术，如监督微调（SFT）、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）和直接偏好优化（DPO）。我们还探讨了从人类偏好中学习的理论基础，并将其与逆强化学习（IRL）和离散选择模型建立了联系。我们以教程的形式介绍了最先进的算法，讨论了它们的优势与局限性，并为实际应用提供了见解。本文旨在为研究人员和从业者提供一份全面的参考资料，既包含对对齐方法论的基础理解，也为开发更稳健、更可扩展的对齐技术提供了框架。
tldr: 本文系统介绍了大语言模型对齐的数学基础与算法框架，涵盖SFT、RLHF和DPO等主流技术，并将其理论与逆强化学习和离散选择模型建立联系，为开发更稳健、可扩展的对齐方法提供了全面参考。
en_tdlr: This article provides a comprehensive tutorial on the mathematical foundations and algorithmic frameworks for aligning LLMs with human feedback, covering SFT, RLHF, and DPO, and connecting preference learning theory to inverse reinforcement learning and discrete choice models to support the development of more robust and scalable alignment techniques.
